questions.question: What does Suguru Geto look like?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto

answer.item: Suguru is a tall, slim, and muscular man with long black hair partially tied up in a man bun while the rest drapes down his back.

questions.question: What color are Suguru Geto's eyes?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto

answer.item: He has thin purple eyes and bangs that occasionally cover the left eye.

questions.question: What was Suguru Geto's hair like in 2006?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto

answer.item: In 2006, Suguru's hair was much shorter as a student, most of it tied up but his bangs were still as prominent.

questions.question: How did Suguru Geto's hair change after August 2007?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto

answer.item: After August 2007 when Suguru became a curse user, his hair began to grow longer and reflect the length it is in 2017.

questions.question: What did Suguru Geto wear as a student?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto

answer.item: As a student, Suguru wore a normal jujutsu high uniform.

questions.question: What does Suguru Geto wear while masquerading as a Buddhist priest?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto

answer.item: He sports a gold-colored kāṣāya garment over black yukata robes. His monk attire is completed with white tabi socks and zōri sandals.

questions.question: Why was Suguru Geto deemed the worst of all curse users?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto

answer.item: Suguru Geto was one of just four special grade sorcerers and was deemed the worst of all curse users due to the level of danger he presented to humanity.

questions.question: Who shared the reputation of being the strongest with Suguru Geto as a student?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto

answer.item: As a student, Suguru and Satoru were both considered "the strongest".

questions.question: What was Suguru Geto capable of against experienced curse users?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto

answer.item: Suguru was capable of making short work of experienced curse users on multiple occasions with little effort.

questions.question: What was notable about Suguru Geto's collection of cursed spirits?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto

answer.item: His collection of cursed spirits was wide with a high variety of different abilities and roles in battle.

questions.question: Was Suguru Geto dependent on his curses in battle?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto

answer.item: Suguru was not overly dependent on his curses and was a highly capable close-quarters fighter as well.

questions.question: How did Suguru Geto use his religious group as a curse user?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto

answer.item: During his time as a curse user, Suguru used his religious group as a lure to collect thousands of cursed spirits.

questions.question: How long did it take for Suguru Geto to become the biggest threat to humanity?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto

answer.item: Over the course of a decade, Suguru became a bigger threat to humanity than any curse at the time.

questions.question: What did Suguru Geto have enough power to do as a curse user?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto

answer.item: With thousands of curses and several curse users by his side, Suguru had enough power behind him to declare war on Jujutsu High, the cornerstone of the jujutsu community.

questions.question: What was the true goal of the Night Parade of a Hundred Demons?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto

answer.item: The true goal of the Night Parade of a Hundred Demons was to kill Yuta and steal special grade vengeful spirit Rika Orimoto from him.

questions.question: What would have allowed Suguru Geto to succeed against Yuta Okkotsu?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto

answer.item: If his curses were not split between Kyoto and Shinjuku, Suguru would have been successful.

questions.question: What does Cursed Spirit Manipulation allow Suguru Geto to do?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto

answer.item: As the name implies, Suguru's technique allows him to control vagabond cursed spirits.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Cursed Technique

questions.question: How does Suguru Geto absorb dominated cursed spirits?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto

answer.item: Dominated curses are absorbed into small black orbs that Suguru must ingest orally in order to use.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Cursed Technique

questions.question: Under what condition can Suguru Geto absorb a curse with no consequences?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto

answer.item: If the difference in grade is around two levels or higher, Suguru can absorb a curse with no consequences.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Cursed Technique

questions.question: How can Suguru Geto absorb the curses of another sorcerer?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto

answer.item: He's also able to absorb other sorcerer's curses as long as he kills the master first.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Cursed Technique

questions.question: What does the maximum technique of Cursed Spirit Manipulation combine?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto

answer.item: The maximum technique of Cursed Spirit Manipulation combines a massive number of collected curses into one powerful attack.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Cursed Technique

questions.question: How many curses did Suguru Geto use in his maximum technique?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto

answer.item: Suguru used over four thousand curses in his maximum technique during the climax of his battle with Yuta and Rika.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Cursed Technique

questions.question: What is Suguru Geto's barrier technique Curtain?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto

answer.item: A type of barrier that is cast over a large area to hide everything within it from the outside world.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Cursed Technique

questions.question: Can Suguru Geto cast Curtain over a weaker sorcerer's barrier?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto

answer.item: Suguru can cast curtains capable of trapping sorcerers inside of it and can do so over another weaker sorcerer's barrier as well.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Cursed Technique

questions.question: What is the Playful Cloud?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto

answer.item: A special grade cursed tool Suguru used to fight Yuta and Rika at the same time.

questions.question: What could Suguru Geto do with the Playful Cloud in battle?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto

answer.item: He was effectively able to block, parry, and counter-attack against both adversaries at the same time with the three-section staff.
